news.title: Army postpones controlled lead detonation after pleas from Iowa lawmakers
news.summary: Acting Army Secretary Adam Telle announced he would be postponing Friday’s detonations of lead azide barrels in Iowa amid heavy pushback from lawmakers who say they were given short notice about the planned explosions. “Public safety is the Army’s top priority, and I have directed Army Materiel Command to postpone tomorrow’s controlled detonation at the…
